description.short: Chat with enabled Claude, Gemini, or Azure OpenAI models.
description.full: A personal chat agent with streamed responses from enabled Claude, Gemini, or Azure OpenAI models. Prompts and recent context are sent to the selected model endpoint. Separate histories expire after 24 hours. Use model to choose an enabled provider, reset to clear app-held context, and help for details.

commands.title: model
commands.description: View or choose an enabled Claude, Gemini, or Azure OpenAI provider

commands.title: reset
commands.description: Clear all providers' app-held histories and model selection

commands.title: help
commands.description: Show usage, limits, and privacy information
